summary: Brother of Maria Antonia DiBiasi and John's 3rd great-granduncle, who came from Guardia Lombardi to Scranton, Pennsylvania, and died there in 1922.
bio:
Domenico Antonio DiBiasi was born on 28 September 1856 at Guardia Lombardi in Avellino, Campania, Italy, a brother of Maria Antonia DiBiasi and so John's 3rd great-granduncle. He married Victoria DiPietro and settled in Scranton, Pennsylvania. Their son John N. DiBiasi (1892–1974) had a son Nicholas (1919–2002). Domenico died at Scranton on 8 February 1922 and was buried in Dunmore.

His widow Victoria was still living in 1940, aged 78, with their son John and his family on Bunker Hill Street, a few doors from the grocery kept by Grace (Petrillo) DiBiasi and from the Petriello family home.

b. 28 Sep 1856 Guardia Lombardi; d. 8 Feb 1922 Scranton; buried in Dunmore. Married Victoria DiPietro; son John N. (1892-1974) had a son Nicholas (1919-2002).

His widow Victoria (78, born Italy) was living in April 1940 with their son John DiBiasi (46) and his family at 1009 Bunker Hill Street. That was a few doors from Grace (Petrillo) DiBiasi's grocery at no. 1015 and the Petriello house at no. 1028 ([R4-S1]).
